register_decomposition_for_op: register a decomposition function for a PyTorch aten op using maybe_register_decomposition decorator
register_jvp_decomposition: register a decomposition function for the JVP-specific decomposition table using register_decomposition_for_jvp
compute_trace_decomposition: compute the trace of a tensor by summing its diagonal elements via the trace decomposition

recompute_mean_var_for_jvp: recompute mean and variance from input and inverse standard deviation so gradients track through normalization
